name: Miake Sawa
source:
Part of unit Eme☆Kare

He is the mediator within the unit and "everyone's reliable older brother".
For better or worse, his earnest efforts in trying to be helpful sometimes backfire. He grew up with Tenjin Haruto and Miwa Tomoe in the same orphanage.
